gaps: Breath one treated each standing as a currency with an exchange rate. The refusals refused to line up that way: the bought title, the donor with the microphone, the referee with a fee, and the credential without a witness all fail for one reason that is not a rate, namely that the entry had to be written by someone other than the holder. This produced the changed question for breath two: where the standing is stored and who must write it, which split standing into bearer form (money, beauty, hands) and registry form (respect, credit, title, seniority).
accepted: Unrefusable glance: beauty converts into audience through attention the audience does not choose to pay, as the pretty busker draws the crowd the better player did not, and nobody has to decide anything for the conversion to run; the rate is highest at first sight and falls with exposure, and the same beauty converts into credit at a discount, because attention that was not chosen is not read as anyone's judgment.

Furniture's ear: access converts into information in proportion to how little standing the person present has, as valets, drivers, interpreters, and the junior aide hear what the visiting minister is performed for; high standing buys the stage and low standing buys the wings, and the conversion is refused to whoever the room notices, so the rate falls the moment one is promoted.

Collar on loan: office converts into deference on sight, but the standing belongs to the office and is lent to the body inside it, as the uniform, the collar, and the robe convert with strangers and not with the congregation that knows the man; refused conversion into personal standing, since it stays with the collar when he takes it off, and impersonating an officer is the fraud of borrowing without the loan.

Familiarity as vetting: fame converts into credit because a recognized name is processed as a prior acquaintance, as the actor is trusted with a policy and the television doctor with a supplement; generous in every domain the audience does not itself practice, and refused inside the guild, whose members meet the same name as a stranger's, so the rate is set by the audience's ignorance rather than by the fame.

Witnessed save: competence converts into deference through a moment with stakes that others saw, as the night nurse who caught the tenfold dose is deferred to by physicians for years afterward; a credential claims the same competence without the witness and converts at a fraction, so the rate is set by the stakes and the audience present, not by the skill, and the competent who were never in the room hold an unconverted balance.

Scar tariff: sacrifice converts into authority in proportion to what cannot be recovered, as the veteran, the striker who lost the house, and the founder who ate the lean years are heard before the unscarred; compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing, since a paid martyr is an employee, and stolen valor is the fraud of claiming the authority without having paid the tariff.

Injury as license: grievance converts into standing through the injured party's right to speak first and to be answered, as the bereaved mother addresses the legislature and the wronged employee is given the floor; refused once compensation is accepted, because the payment closes the account, and refused again when the injury was manufactured or bought, while whether it may be inherited past living memory is contested and this map leaves it so.

Introducer's tab: credit converts into access through a third party who spends his own standing to open the door, as the referee, the letter-writer, and the friend who says take the meeting; the rate is charged to the introducer and not to the introduced, which is why a paid introduction converts at nothing and the referee with a fee is the fraud. Adds to the exchange-ontologies item Vouching the shape of the rate: the converter pays, so credit moves only as fast as someone will be billed for it.

Gift that keeps no hand: money converts into respect only by being given away, with the rate set by how completely the giver lets go, as the hospital wing carries the donor's name but not the donor's vote on who is treated; refused, and re-read as a purchase, the moment the donor wants the microphone, so the same dollars buy respect or buy contempt depending only on whether a hand stays on them.

Immunity by entanglement: seniority converts into immunity as the institution's memory and other people's careers come to run through one person, so that removal costs more than tolerance, as the thirty-year clerk and the surgeon who trained every attending are forgiven what a newcomer would be fired for; refused the day a successor is trained, which is why the hoarder who keeps the only keys is the fraud form of the same mechanism.

Refusal premium: authority is conferred on those seen not to want it, as the monastery elects the monk who hid from the vote and the meeting names as clerk the member who declined twice; the conversion is open only to those who do not perform it, so reluctance on camera is the fraud, and the premium is refused precisely to whoever asks for it, which makes it the one conversion an operator cannot run on purpose.

Evidence that spending erases: conferred standing is valuable as evidence of someone else's judgment, so buying it destroys what was bought, as the purchased title, the self-financed candidate, and the bought followers each announce that no one else would have conferred them; the one-way rule of the map, that whatever standing functions as another party's verdict cannot be converted into by money, only by a verdict-giver who is not the holder and gains nothing from him.

residue.item: Counted crowd: audience converts into institutional credit at face value because numbers travel where reputations do not, as the label signs the follower count.
residue.why: Merged into Evidence that spending erases: its whole interest was the refusal (a bought count announces the crowd would not come), which is the same one-way rule; the case survives there as bought followers.

residue.item: Yard reputation: violence converts into safety and a share of trade through the witnessed fight.
residue.why: Rejected: a currency variant of Witnessed save, with the same operator (a moment with stakes that others saw) and nothing new about the rate or the fraud; kept out so the save item is read as a mechanism rather than a nurse story.

residue.item: Status symbols: the watch, the car, the postcode.
residue.why: Rejected: display is a signal about standing already held, not a conversion between forms; the brief excludes it and nothing was lost by obeying.

residue.item: Pack rank: dominance in a wolf pack converting into feeding order.
residue.why: Rejected: the remote domain did not sharpen anything, since both sides of the supposed conversion are the same kind of standing; the monastery served the map better and became Refusal premium.

residue.item: Bribery: money converts into a favorable decision.
residue.why: Held as the boundary case rather than admitted: it converts money into an act, not into a balance anyone can present as a verdict; stated in gate.checks.boundary_case.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork in a separated mixture of registers: the mechanisms are analytical and the cases are observed and simplified to one mechanism each; no exchange rate is measured, and none is claimed to hold across cultures or periods.
The seriation is an itinerary by who must write the entry, not a ranking of legitimacy, of yield, or of how much any conversion is worth; the edges are conditional authored claims.

Bearer standing and registry standing are an authored distinction, not a claim that any standing is purely one or the other; competence is bearer-form in the hands and registry-form in the reputation, and several items live on the seam.

Conversions called fraud here are those the communities involved refuse; the map does not judge whether each refusal is just, and the inheritance of grievance standing in particular is left contested inside its own item.

Coercion (standing extracted by threat) and inheritance (standing passed by birth) are outside the list except where they appear as fraud cases or as time-denominated admission; whether fear can be laundered into honor is held as a seed.

gaps: The changed question yielded the registry members: a credential as a bearer copy of an entry (Notarized standing), an entry that stays home (Standing left at the border), an entry that expires (Staleness discount), a registry that accepts only years (Time as the only tender), and the two conversions that cross the seam backward, standing into hands (Practice given to the trusted) and standing into money (Cashing out). The territory pointer 'status conversions' stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now says by whom the entry is written, and the live question resolved into a rule: standing that functions as another party's verdict cannot be bought, because buying supplies the holder's own verdict and erases the evidence.
accepted: Practice given to the trusted: standing converts back into competence, the reverse of the witnessed save, because whoever is already deferred to is handed the hard cases and becomes what he was presumed, as the resident the chief likes is given the interesting surgeries; the rate is generous and the product is indistinguishable afterward from competence that earned its own presumption, which is the discount nobody can collect.

Cashing out: standing converts into money through the endorsement, the paid speech, the board seat, and the memoir, at a generous rate that consumes the stock, as the retired general and the musician who sells the jingle each spend some of what they sell; the reverse conversion must pass through the gift, so the round trip from money to respect to money leaks in both directions, and the undisclosed endorsement is the fraud of cashing standing while still presenting it as uncashed.

Notarized standing: a credential is a bearer copy of an entry held in someone else's ledger, which is what lets conferred standing cross a border or a decade at all, as the ship's master's ticket converts into command on any deck that honors the issuing authority; converts only between registries that recognize each other, and the diploma mill is the fraud of printing the copy with no entry behind it.

Standing left at the border: conferred standing is a balance in the conferrers' ledger and not in the holder, so it does not travel with the body, as the Damascus surgeon who drives a taxi in Berlin is exactly as skilled and has lost all deference; the conversion fails by venue rather than by rate, and the local registry prices re-entry as if from zero, because it never wrote the entry it is being asked to honor.

Staleness discount: an entry in the registry expires unless it is re-witnessed, so the carpenter six years out of work loses credit at a rate set by the length of the gap and not by any change in the hands; the refusal here is temporal where the border's is spatial, a document repairs one and only a fresh shift repairs the other, and the padded résumé is the fraud of inventing witnesses for the missing years.

Time as the only tender: belonging is conferred by insiders in a currency that cannot be accelerated, as the newly rich are admitted a generation later, the parish accepts the incomer's children, and prison seniority is counted in years actually served; the rate is fixed at one year per year and no sum buys a second year inside the same year, so the forged pedigree is the fraud and patience is not a virtue here but the price.

residue.item: Inherited name: standing converts across a generation by birth, as the son of the judge is credited before he has judged.
residue.why: Rejected: a transfer inside one registry between holders, not a conversion between forms of standing; it appears only as the fraud of the forged pedigree and as the contested clause of Injury as license.

residue.item: Fear laundered: threat converts into deference, and across a generation into honor, as the warlord's grandson sits on the foundation board.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: fear converts into compliance that looks like deference but is refused entry into any registry (the feared are obeyed and not honored); it needs a mechanism by which the entry gets written later, probably through Gift that keeps no hand plus Time as the only tender, before admission, and the map's fifth boundary claim holds the door open.

neighbors.separating_case: A nurse still employed in Kraków applying in Manchester has current witnesses and the wrong registry; a Manchester nurse six years out of work applying in Manchester has the right registry and no recent entry. A recognition agreement between the two registries repairs the first case and does nothing for the second, and a single supervised shift repairs the second and does nothing for the first, so the two refusals have different operators even though both leave a competent nurse unconverted.

checks.boundary_case: Bribery is out: money converts into a decision, not into standing. The official confers nothing and the payer holds no balance afterward; the act is the whole product, and the fraud is the act rather than the conversion. Introducer's tab is in on exactly that contrast, since the bribed official spends nothing of his own while the introducer spends standing, and what the payer of a bribe gets cannot be presented to a third party as anyone's verdict on him.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the sequence conceals, Witnessed save to Practice given to the trusted, where deference earned by one save buys the cases that produce the next, with an entry problem for whoever has not yet saved. It shows an incompatibility, Witnessed save to Furniture's ear, where being noticed and hearing cannot be held by one body in one room. It shows a fork, Scar tariff to Cashing out, where sacrifice splits at compensation into authority or salary and cannot keep both. It shows a dependency, Notarized standing to Standing left at the border, where the border fires only if registries fail to recognize each other and no act of the holder repairs it. And it shows a passage between levels, Time as the only tender to Staleness discount, where a rule about how a person is admitted becomes a property of the registry's clock, which confers and forgets at the same fixed rate and runs one way.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a conversion, its carrier, a shape for the rate, and a place where it is called fraud, in the survivor's register rather than as advice; the strange members (an ear that works better the lower one stands, a premium paid only to those who do not ask, a purchase that erases what it buys, a registry that accepts only years) are kept as mechanisms and not softened into counsel about humility or patience.

next_crossfield_opening: The registrar who must not be the holder: connect Evidence that spending erases with witness-architectures' Arm's-length custody (a fact witnessed only when its record lives beyond the subject's reach) and with what-a-price-does' prices that work by never being paid; ask whether every standing that cannot be bought is exactly a fact held in a ledger the holder cannot write, and whether Refusal premium is that ledger's rule against self-entry.

gaps: The of-sentence promises each item a fraud site and six of eighteen delivered none (Unrefusable glance, Furniture's ear, Familiarity as vetting, Witnessed save, Practice given to the trusted, Standing left at the border), two of them the most instructive fraud forms on the map, the planted ear and the staged save. Scar tariff's 'compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing' contradicted its own salaried veteran and was identical to Injury as license's refusal, so the neighbors collapsed until compensation was re-read as a loss priced before it was taken rather than an account closed after. The self-financed candidate mis-exemplified the closing rule (the voters still write the entry). The bearer/registry distinction, the loop, the incompatibility, the itinerary, and the closing rule itself held.

residue.why: The critic flagged that 'no sum buys a second year' survives the donor made trustee only by reclassifying fast admission as a purchase, and asked the item to say so; no repair text was supplied and the defense already lives in the Gift that keeps no hand to Evidence that spending erases edge, so the item is kept as written rather than extended by the repairer.

The critic found its band arguable (it accrues without a decision, like the glance) but did not argue a reorder and accepted the author's reading of institutional dependence as the writer; the walk is kept.

limits: Coercion (standing extracted by threat) and inheritance (standing passed by birth) are outside the list except where they appear as fraud cases or as time-denominated admission; whether fear can be laundered into honor is held as a seed, and marriage into standing, where the receiving family gains from the holder and writes the entry anyway, is absent and untested against the closing rule (the critic's seed).
seed: Marriage as registrar. The conversion every novel runs, the mill-owner's money into the baronet's name and the beauty into the house, is absent, and it is the one case that tests the closing rule, because the writer of the new entry (the receiving family) gains from the holder and writes the entry anyway. Either the family name is a registry that launders a purchase into a conferral by Time as the only tender, so that the purchase clause is dropped from the grandchildren's entry, or the one-way rule has an exception wherever the verdict-giver is bound for life to the verdict. The author's own held seed, fear laundered into honor across a generation, is the same question with threat in place of money. A probe: take three marriages into standing and find at which generation the purchase stops being mentioned in the receiving registry, and whether a divorce reopens it.
